hypothesis: Using JRA current odds rather than predicted odds when recalculating calibrated non-win ticket EV will make displayed EV, threshold checks, and portfolio EV consistent and safer.
conceptual_change: Separate current and predicted odds inside _calibrate_ticket_probabilities.
decision_reason: Validation ROI tied and score did not improve. The fixed validation fixture contains no evaluated non-win tickets, so it cannot measure this change.
follow_up: Add independently collected multi-race combo-bet validation coverage through the normal dataset governance process before retrying this fix. Do not add the reviewed race directly to validation for the purpose of making this patch pass.
